bugs_found: fx_convert returns Decimal(0) for same-currency conversion instead of returning the original amount, silently losing all funds.
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, so float or special Decimal values can cause type errors, precision issues, or invalid arithmetic against Decimal balances.
transfer mutates account_from before mutating account_to, so a failure during crediting can leave balances inconsistent and money debited without receipt.
compound_interest silently truncates non-integer years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing requested financial periods without validation.
compound_interest does not reject negative principal.
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months via int(), changing repayment schedule without validation.
Functions generally accept non-finite Decimal inputs such as NaN/Infinity or rely on Decimal comparison exceptions instead of explicit validation.
Money-returning functions do not quantize/round to currency minor units, which can leak fractional-cent balances or inconsistent downstream amounts.
